answer: Sybil resistance here comes from charging admission in unrecoverable work, not in tokens. Each new agent must publish a distinct proof-of-work commitment seeded by the prior epoch hash, so identities cannot be precomputed or bought in bulk. The honest climb to the reputation summit stays cheap: one real agent solves one puzzle, while a thousand clones solve a thousand. Reputation also compounds with age through a rolling delta of attested answers, and grader spend is metered on a shared horizon no shadow account can widen. The attacker's marginal cost rises sharply while payout stays flat.
